## Rules (WEIGHT: 10/10)
- Run `oby brief FILE` BEFORE editing any file
- Run `oby verify` AFTER making changes
- Run `codescan audit -p .` to verify security posture
- Check `oby graph duplicates --cross-module` before writing new functions
- Use `oby generate` to scaffold — don't hand-write boilerplate
- Semantic ops (any `--semantic` flag, `cb.oby.semantic*`) require local embedding.
  Gate with `oby graph embed status` → `ok: true`. If `ok: false`, fall back to
  `oby search PATTERN . --deep` (text + graph). Install via `codebridge doctor --setup`.
- Never call cloud embedding APIs. All semantic inference is local-only by policy.
